<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that represents a Hiyama coupling (formation of a C–C bond between a vinylsilane and an aryl halide). To find such a template, we will search the template catalog for reactions that form a carbon–carbon single bond (bond type “6-6”).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
